commit_message: Implement ADR 0131 AI Studio agent host
pr_title: GameEngine: implement conversational AI Studio agent host
pr_body:
## Summary

- implements the first architecture-preserving ADR 0131 capability slice with GUI-free AI session, proposal, run, event, permission, persistence, code-workspace, provider, asset, and completion contracts
- adds the modeless AI Studio Editor frontend for conversation, proposals, Go, permissions, audit, cancellation, and local/shared persistence
- updates the canonical authoring specification sections 16-18 for the new agent-runtime, permission, and collaboration boundaries

Concrete external/native runtime adapters and autonomous playtest execution remain follow-up capabilities behind these contracts.

## Validation

Run Windows Validation through the repository dispatcher. Editor UI changes require Visual Validation.
